title: Pulsar Sipper Replacement Glass Bubbler (taxes extra)
description:
These glass bubbler attachments are an official replacement part for the Pulsar Sipper Vaporizer. Made from quality borosilicate glass, the Sipper Bubbler Cup adds water filtration to the vaping experience, providing the smoothest hits from dabs and 510 cartridges. These bubbler cup can be used with the Sipper’s Auto-Fill function to draw vapor hands free; then it can be removed so customers can sip at will.

Pulsar Sipper Bubbler Features:
6.5″ Tall
Bubbler Cup Attachment
Borosilicate Glass
Official Replacement Part for the Pulsar Sipper Vaporizer

What’s in the Box:
1x – Pulsar Sipper Replacement Glass Bubbler
